name: SecretVault::with_secret

test_list.description: The closure receives the loaded secret as a borrowed string for the duration of the call.
An absent entry returns NotFound without invoking the closure.
Debug formatting of vault and sealed values never contains a canary secret.
The owned secret wrapper cannot reveal its value through Debug or Display.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The key identifying the sealed entry.

inputs.name: f
inputs.description: A synchronous callback that cannot retain the borrowed plaintext through the vault API.

output_description: The closure result after temporary decryption, or a typed error.
